definitions.explanation: An extremely short period of time.

examples.japanese: その{瞬間|しゅんかん}、{時|とき}が{止|と}まったように{感|かん}じた。
examples.english: At that moment, it felt like time had stopped.

examples.japanese: {瞬間|しゅんかん}{移動|いどう}ができたらいいのに。
examples.notes: 瞬間移動 = teleportation (lit. instant movement)

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}と{目|め}が{合|あ}った{瞬間|しゅんかん}、{心臓|しんぞう}がドキッとした。あの{時|とき}から{恋|こい}が{始|はじ}まったのかもしれない。
examples.english: The moment our eyes met, my heart skipped a beat. Maybe that was when I fell in love.

notes:
{瞬間|しゅんかん} refers to an instant or moment - an extremely brief period of time.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- その{瞬間|しゅんかん} (at that moment)
- ○○した{瞬間|しゅんかん} (the moment when ~)
- {瞬間|しゅんかん}的に (instantly, momentarily)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {瞬間|しゅんかん}{移動|いどう} (teleportation)
- {瞬間|しゅんかん}{接着剤|せっちゃくざい} (instant glue)
- {決定的|けっていてき}{瞬間|しゅんかん} (decisive moment)
- {瞬間|しゅんかん}{最大|さいだい}{風速|ふうそく} (maximum instantaneous wind speed)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {瞬間|しゅんかん}: instant, moment (very short)
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}: an instant (emphasis on brevity)
- {瞬|またた}く{間|ま} (に): in the blink of an eye
- {時|とき}: time, moment (more general)
